normalize_lora_state_dict: normalize any LoRA state dict from multiple formats into a single canonical layout with lora_A/lora_B naming
detect_lora_format_from_state_dict: detect the LoRA format of a state dict by inspecting its key patterns without loading the model
convert_lora_state_dict_by_format: convert a LoRA state dict from a detected format into the standard A/B weight naming convention
convert_ai_toolkit_flux_lora: convert ai-toolkit Flux LoRA with double_blocks/single_blocks naming to diffusers transformer_blocks format
LoRAFormat_enum: use the LoRAFormat enum to identify supported external LoRA formats including standard, kohya, xlabs, qwen image, and wan
